notes.TWN: 台灣平均每 1 kWp 每天約可發 3.51 度電（一年約 1,281 度），在 235 個國家中排第 196（世界陸地平均 4.30）。北部冬季多雲：台北盆地約 3.1、基隆約 2.9；台南到高雄的平原約 4.0；高山因為空氣稀薄、氣溫低也不低。Global Solar Atlas 網站上的台灣摘要（舊版資料、它自己的國界）是 3.44。

notesEn.TWN: In Taiwan, 1 kWp of PV yields about 3.51 kWh a day (about 1,281 kWh a year), ranking 196 of 235 (world land average 4.30). The north is cloudy in winter: about 3.1 in the Taipei Basin and 2.9 in Keelung, against about 4.0 on the Tainan–Kaohsiung plain; the mountains also score well thanks to thin, cool air. The Global Solar Atlas website's Taiwan summary (older data, its own borders) gives 3.44.
